home.heroTitle:
A home for the days
we spend together.
home.intro: This is a keepsake for our family. Not a grand story—just the places we go, the things we say, and the ordinary days we want time to remember for us.
home.albumIntro: Our album grows slowly with time. It is not about perfect composition, only about keeping our moments where they belong.
home.journeyIntro: The moments from our travels become small films we can return to—the wind, the laughter, and every step still easy to hear.
home.storiesTitle: Written down, ordinary days begin to echo.
home.storyIntro: Travel notes, small milestones, and the little things we only learn to treasure later.
home.quote:
A keepsake is simply
saying goodbye to today with care.
home.nextIntro: Life keeps moving, and so will the photos and stories. The next chapter is reserved for the sea.
home.nextPlanText: We would like to take our little one to see the sea, walk on the beach, and capture the wind of another trip. A new album will follow once the city and dates are settled.

gallery.title: Album
gallery.intro: Photographs are grouped by trip and time. Open an album to see all of its photos.
gallery.empty: There are no photos in this album yet.
gallery.localHintText: Albums, photo URLs, and written stories are served by the uniCloud database and cloud storage.

journeys.title: Journeys
journeys.intro: A place for the moments from our travels—the wind on the road, sudden laughter, and scenes we will still want to revisit years later.

stories.title: Stories
stories.intro: Articles are stored as Markdown, separate from the page layout. Redesigning the reading experience never requires touching the text.
stories.newArticleText: Create a Markdown article with a title, summary, date, and category. It will appear here automatically.
stories.notFound: This story could not be found.

about.title: About our family
about.intro: We are a family. We love weekend adventures, and equally love doing nothing at home.
about.storyOne: Social media fragments our lives and the feed keeps moving. We wanted a quiet place where photos, videos, and words could stay together.
about.storyTwo: It does not need to be seen by many people. It only needs to remind us, years from now, what we ate, where the wind touched us, and the lovely things our child said.
about.memberOne: Drives, takes photos, and makes the itinerary too ambitious.
about.memberTwo: Finds beautiful light, good food, and the exact moment to stop and rest.
about.memberThree: Creates surprises, asks the most questions, and makes most of the laughter.
about.stackIntro: From rendering and image delivery to the CMS, this family archive is built with a small set of mature open-source tools.
about.stackFrontendText: Handles routing, server rendering, APIs, and type safety so photos and words feel fast on a phone.
about.stackDesignText: Builds the responsive layout, theme details, and restrained page transitions with a content-first rhythm.
about.stackCloudText: Stores albums, videos, stories, and banners while serving optimized images through the CDN.
about.stackContentText: Powers Markdown stories and the bilingual interface, keeping every family note readable and well organized.
about.stackInteractionText: Supports themes, favorites, album selection, and accessible menus and dialogs.
about.stackDeliveryText: Provides installability, image processing, Markdown parsing, and automated deployment while keeping the site light.
about.creditsText: Thank you to Nuxt, Vue.js, Tailwind CSS, Pinia, VueUse, Reka UI, Motion for Vue, Nuxt Content, Nuxt i18n, Nuxt Image, Nuxt Icon, Vite PWA, Sharp, Marked, Ant Design Vue, and all their maintainers and contributors.
about.creditsNote: These openly shared and carefully maintained tools let an ordinary family preserve its memories in its own way.
about.anniversaryIntro: Since the day we chose to walk side by side, we have kept one photo for every year. Photos age, life moves on, and we keep choosing each other.
about.anniversaryTwoNote: Still my favorite place to lean in
about.anniversaryFutureNote: Room for every year to come
about.anniversaryQuote: The photos change year after year. You are still the person beside me.
